# CMS MCP connectors

8 CMS connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All CMS connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/cms](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/cms).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Contentful](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/contentful-to-mcp) | Let your AI work with your Contentful content: search entries and assets, read content types, locales and tags, and create, change, publish or unpublish entries. | 20 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-contentful-to-muse) |
| [Directus](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/directus-to-mcp) | Connect to a Directus instance (self-hosted or Directus Cloud) to discover collections and fields, query items, and retrieve individual records through the read-only REST API. | 5 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-directus-to-muse) |
